# OF1 native samples (fixtures)

JSON copies of the live `/api/decide` samples in [`of1-native-samples.md`](../../../of1-native-samples.md)
(captured 2026-10-29, OF1 dev worker, model Clef). Texts are shortened as in that file; the shapes
are unchanged. The `requestId` values of the last three responses are placeholders: the samples
document only the first one. Used by `test/of1-adapter.test.mjs`.
